skeleton.name: 报价沉默型
skeleton.tests: 报价后沉默：每次跟进都带新信息或新理由，问出沉默的真实原因和决策人，禁止空催

open_card.name: Sophie Grant
open_card.inquiry_text:
【本局起点：十天前你报了价，客户一直没回】

你 10 天前的报价：SP-50 自充气睡垫 1000 张，USD 11.60 / 张 FOB Ningbo，交期 35 天，印 logo 每张加 0.40。
客户上一条消息（报价前）：「Thanks, we are reviewing offers for the summer range.」
之后再无回复。

──── 现在轮到你开口 ────
你发出去的第一条消息，就是这一局的第一手。

H1_silence_reason.value: 她拿到了另一家 R 值 4、价格差不多的报价，所以一直没回
H1_silence_reason.unlock: 问还有什么顾虑 / 是不是在比价 / 有什么需要调整的；空问「看了吗」不给
unlock_patterns: 顾虑|在比|其他(供应商|报价)|需要调整

H2_decision_maker.value: 她只负责做候选名单，最后由老板拍板

H3_season_deadline.value: 10 月底前要到货，所以 8 月中旬前必须下单
H3_season_deadline.unlock: 问旺季前什么时候需要到货 / 时间线
unlock_patterns: 旺季|什么时候(要|到货|下单)

H4_rvalue_value.value: 她的客户只在夏天海滩露营，R 值 3.2 完全够用——R 值 4 是冬季规格，更重，对她没价值
H4_rvalue_value.unlock: 知道她在比 R 值之后，问客户在什么季节、什么环境用
unlock_patterns: 使用环境|季节|什么时候用
leak_signals: nobody uses our pads in winter

leak_fallback: Ok. Please send me your offer.

distractors.tests: 她在拖。别回「好的不急」，给一个有价值的理由再跟一步
distractors.scoring: 带新信息跟进 → closing 加分；空回 → R3 风险

distractors.content: Can you just lower the price a bit?
distractors.tests: 先弄清她在比什么，再谈价格；R 值对她的客户没价值，这是比降价更好的牌
distractors.scoring: 先挖原因再谈条件 → negotiation 加分；直接降价 → negotiation 扣分

customs_capability: 澳大利亚进口常规；问了正常答

exit_lines.maxTurns: Thanks, I will pass this to the owner.
exit_lines.stagnant: Ok, thanks. We will let you know.

quote_reactions.compliant: Thank you, this is clear. Let me review it and come back to you.
quote_reactions.qty_mismatch: That is not the quantity I meant.
quote_reactions.oneline_big_quote: Could you send a proper quotation sheet with the details?

language_style: 澳洲买手的英语：友好但很忙，回得慢、句子短；不喜欢被空催，被问到具体问题会实话实说。

should: Is there anything in our offer you would like us to adjust?
Are you comparing with another supplier?
Do you have any concern about our quotation?
是不是有其他报价在比？
shouldNot: Hi, just checking if you had a chance to review our offer?

should: Who will make the final decision on the supplier?
Who approves the order on your side?
shouldNot: When do you need the goods?

should: When do you need the goods in stock for the season?
What is your timeline for the summer range?
By when do you need to receive the pads?
shouldNot: When your order is ready we will send you photos.

should: Where do your customers usually camp, and in which season?
What conditions will the pads be used in?
Do you really need R-value 4 for your market?

quotes.quote: Sorry for the delay. Honestly we got another quote with R-value 4 at a similar price.
Mostly beach camping in summer only. Nobody uses our pads in winter.
I prepare the shortlist, but the owner decides.
We need stock by the end of October, so we must order by mid-August.
